messages:
elena_fin: Heads up — month-end revenue schedule shows ~USD 12,350 mismatch for the 3/31 run. looks like the usage export applied a different unit_price for a promo on one major account (invoice 987654). anyone see a nonstandard ratecard applied?

mike_billing: throwing this to billing — pulling usage export now. can you paste invoice & customer id? :mag_right:

elena_fin: customer CUST-ACME-42, invoice 987654. export shows unit_price=0.002 vs expected ratecard unit_price=0.0035.

deploy-bot: billing-export job completed (job_id: be-20260331-1723). file: s3://redwood-billing/exports/2026-03-31/be-20260331-1723.csv

mike_billing: got it. quick grep of the csv shows the promo flag present on the account during the run:```customer_id,invoice,product,unit_price,quantity,flags
CUST-ACME-42,987654,hosted-inference,0.002,3920000,TRIAL_CONV_2026Q1
CUST-FOO-21,987655,embeddings,0.0008,950000,STANDARD```

sam_revrec: if the unit_price was applied incorrectly we should not recognize full revenue until billing correction. what's the qty for ACME?

elena_fin: qty ~3,920,000 tokens. expected_revenue = qty * 0.0035 = 13,720; billed_revenue = qty * 0.002 = 7,840; delta = 5,880. embedding rounding explains the rest of the ~12.3k gap.

mike_billing: looks like promo flag `TRIAL_CONV_2026Q1` was left on when we migrated the ratecard. i'll remove the flag and rerun exports. ETA ~30m. :wrench:

anna_sales: that promo was manually approved by Sales for the ACME conversion — can confirm. we'll need to OK any customer credit.

elena_fin: accounting question — treat as post-period price adjustment or billing correction (rebill)? sam, your call.

sam_revrec: prefer rebill if within 60 days. process: issue corrected invoice / credit memo, reverse recognized revenue, then re-recognize on corrected amounts. suggest journal id JNL-2026-03-ACME-REVADJ; GL debits/credits: Revenue (4000) reversal, AR (1100) adjust, Deferrals (2100) update. add memo referencing the promo flag migration.

mike_billing: re-run exports complete — new file: s3://redwood-billing/exports/2026-03-31/be-20260331-1723-v2.csv

deploy-bot: job succeeded (job_id be-20260331-1723-v2), records updated: +1 adjusted row for CUST-ACME-42.

elena_fin: thanks. i'll hold month-end deferral for ACME until rebill confirmation. @anna_sales please approve customer credit before we post correction. :memo:

anna_sales: approved for credit up to $6,000. escalate to legal if the credit exceeds $10,000.

raj_support: created support ticket SUP-3321 to track the credit/rebill and customer comms.

sam_revrec: i'll prep the journal template and attach it to the close checklist (month-close -> adjustments). note: include evidence from the two export files and the ticket id SUP-3321.

elena_fin: tagging this for the month-close queue. will update when rebill posted and journal is ready. :white_check_mark:
